test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'OBTAIN' is written as 'NATBOI', and 'BEGGER' is written as 'RGGEBE'. How will 'RUGGED' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is as follows:

1) 'OBTAIN' is written as 'NATBOI'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25ff114d84112bccd7961ae7e20a6445b0ea25b6d81a18cf2b5eeecfe9d7e728.png] 

2) 'BEGGER' is written as 'RGGEBE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/139a272f772bc731e0cfc56e0ca02135227af7c4338de9f15c8dc29229fd2fb2.png] 

Similarly,

3) 'RUGGED' be written '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f9edfeedfa6b2fd79d679ea2c0dd8a1eefa08ff53d9d6af68ff2c1328510ba2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****DGGURE".**
